purpose: Determine whether the public DoltHub options repository exposes a commit snapshot at or before the fixed 2025-08-01 observation date, and independently verify two immutable AS OF snapshots.
fixed_requirements: Require a commit dated on or before 2025-08-01 for true historical PIT readiness.
Query exactly two observed commits with SELECT ... AS OF <commit> on option_chain at the fixed date.
Hash returned rows exactly as received.
No future data, returns, ranking, tuning, holdout selection or performance.

interpretation_rule.PIT_READY: Only when a valid option_chain commit at or before 2025-08-01 is observed and two AS OF snapshots are reproducibly queried.
interpretation_rule.PIT_UNPROVEN: If history exists but no commit at or before the target date is observed; later commits may document revision behavior but do not establish historical PIT.
